name: Donald J. Trump
role: 45th and 47th President of the United States; owner of the Trump Organization (held via trust during presidencies).
summary: Central subject. Business interests include branded real estate licensing, golf and hotel properties, and (from 2024) cryptocurrency ventures.

name: Jared Kushner
role: Son-in-law; Senior Adviser to the President 2017–2021; founder of Affinity Partners (2021); unpaid envoy in Gaza diplomacy (2025–).
summary: Led the first administration's Middle East portfolio, including the 2019 economic plan and the Abraham Accords period. After leaving office he founded Affinity Partners, a private-equity firm funded mainly by Gulf sovereign investors.

name: Ivanka Trump
role: Daughter; Adviser to the President 2017–2021.
summary: Filed public financial disclosures while serving; outside income reported jointly analysed with Jared Kushner's.

name: Eric Trump
role: Son; Executive Vice President, Trump Organization; World Liberty Financial co-founder.
summary: Runs Trump Organization business including Gulf licensing deals; reported signatory of the 2025 World Liberty stake sale.

name: Donald Trump Jr.
role: Son; Executive Vice President, Trump Organization; World Liberty Financial co-founder.
summary: Co-runs the Trump Organization; listed among World Liberty Financial's co-founders.

name: Charles Kushner
role: Jared Kushner's father; founder of Kushner Companies; co-founder of the Charles and Seryl Kushner Foundation.
summary: Family business and foundation are documented separately from Jared Kushner's own holdings.

name: Steve Witkoff
role: Real-estate investor; US Special Envoy to the Middle East (2025–); World Liberty Financial co-founder with his sons.
summary: Not a family member. Included because he is a business partner of the Trump family in World Liberty Financial while serving as a Middle East envoy.

name: Zach Witkoff
role: Son of Steve Witkoff; World Liberty Financial co-founder.
summary: Announced in May 2025 that USD1 would settle MGX's investment in Binance.

name: The Trump Organization
role: Trump family holding company for real estate, licensing, golf and hospitality.
summary: Licenses the Trump name to foreign developers who own and build the projects; the licensor earns fees rather than owning the buildings.

name: World Liberty Financial (WLF)
role: Cryptocurrency venture launched 2024; issuer of the WLFI token and USD1 stablecoin.
summary: Co-founded by Trump family members and the Witkoffs. Trump-family entities (reported as DT Marks DEFI LLC) hold an equity and token interest.

name: Affinity Partners
role: Private-equity firm founded by Jared Kushner in 2021 (Miami).
summary: Limited partners are reported to be predominantly Gulf sovereign wealth funds (Saudi PIF, Qatar's QIA, Abu Dhabi's Lunate). Investments include an Israeli insurer (Phoenix Financial) and a stake in the EA take-private consortium.

name: Kushner Companies
role: Kushner family real-estate company.
summary: Jared Kushner was its CEO before 2017. Owned 666 Fifth Avenue from 2007 until the 2018 Brookfield transaction.

name: Charles and Seryl Kushner Foundation
role: Kushner family charitable foundation.
summary: Tax filings show grants to US nonprofits supporting institutions in West Bank settlements.

name: American Friends of Beit El Yeshiva
role: US fundraising arm of a yeshiva in the Beit El settlement (West Bank).
summary: David Friedman, later US ambassador to Israel, was its president when the Kushner foundation's grants were reported.

name: Dar Global (Dar Al Arkan)
role: London-listed international arm of Saudi developer Dar Al Arkan.
summary: Trump Organization's main Gulf licensing partner since 2022 (Oman, Jeddah, Riyadh, Dubai, Qatar).

name: Phoenix Financial
role: Israeli insurance and investment group (publicly traded, Tel Aviv).
summary: Affinity Partners became its largest shareholder in 2025. Its investment portfolio includes holdings in Israeli defense suppliers.

name: Elbit Systems
role: Israel's largest weapons manufacturer.
summary: Appears here only as a Phoenix Financial portfolio holding identified by CNN; no direct Trump-family holding is documented.

name: Menora Mivtachim
role: Israeli insurer (publicly traded, Tel Aviv).
summary: Invested in Kushner Companies apartment properties in 2017.

name: Bank Hapoalim
role: Israeli bank.
summary: Reported lender to Kushner Companies.

name: Brookfield (Brookfield Property Partners)
role: Canadian asset manager.
summary: Took a 99-year prepaid lease of 666 Fifth Avenue in 2018. The Qatar Investment Authority was a significant investor in Brookfield Property Partners.

name: Electronic Arts (EA)
role: US video-game publisher.
summary: Agreed in September 2025 to a $55 billion take-private by PIF, Silver Lake and Affinity Partners.

name: Silver Lake
role: US private-equity firm.
summary: Co-investor in the EA take-private.

name: Binance
role: Cryptocurrency exchange.
summary: Received MGX's $2 billion minority investment, settled in WLF's USD1 stablecoin.

name: LIV Golf
role: Professional golf league backed by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund.
summary: Has staged tournaments at Trump-owned golf courses since 2022.

name: Crescent Heights
role: US real-estate developer.
summary: Trump's partner in a 2006 Ramat Gan (Israel) land purchase; later sued by the Trump Organization.

name: Preserve America PAC
role: Pro-Trump super PAC.
summary: Principal recipient of Miriam Adelson's 2024 political contributions.

name: Public Investment Fund (Saudi Arabia)
role: Saudi sovereign wealth fund chaired by Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman.
summary: Largest investor in Affinity Partners; LIV Golf's backer; lead investor in the EA take-private.

name: Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
role: Foreign government.
summary: Payments by the Saudi government to Trump properties during 2017–2021 are documented in Mazars records cited by House Oversight Democrats.

name: State of Qatar
role: Foreign government.
summary: Donor of a Boeing 747-8 to the US Department of Defense (2025); owner of Qatari Diar and the QIA.

name: Qatar Investment Authority (QIA)
role: Qatari sovereign wealth fund.
summary: Affinity Partners limited partner (2024); investor in Brookfield Property Partners.

name: Qatari Diar
role: Real-estate company of Qatar's sovereign wealth fund.
summary: Master developer of Simaisma, where a Trump-branded golf club and villas are planned with Dar Global.

name: United Arab Emirates
role: Foreign government.
summary: Party to the Abraham Accords; home of MGX, Lunate and Aryam Investment.

name: Lunate
role: Abu Dhabi investment manager.
summary: Affinity Partners limited partner (2024).

name: MGX
role: Abu Dhabi AI-focused investment firm chaired by Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed.
summary: Invested $2 billion in Binance, settled in USD1.

name: Aryam Investment 1
role: Abu Dhabi entity reported to be backed by Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed.
summary: Reported buyer of a 49% stake in World Liberty Financial (WSJ).

name: Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed Al Nahyan
role: UAE National Security Adviser; chairs MGX and G42.
summary: Linked through MGX and Aryam to two transactions involving World Liberty Financial.

name: Miriam Adelson
role: Israeli-American billionaire and Republican donor.
summary: Largest individual donor to pro-Trump super PAC spending in 2024.

name: Sheldon Adelson (d. 2021)
role: Casino magnate and Republican donor.
summary: Reported in 2018 to have offered to fund part of the Jerusalem embassy.

name: State of Israel (Government)
role: Foreign government.
summary: Counterparty to US recognition decisions, arms sales and peace initiatives; its regulator approved Affinity's Phoenix stake increase.

name: US Department of State
role: Executive department.
summary: Issued the 2019 settlements legal position and 2025 emergency arms-sale determinations.

name: US Department of Defense
role: Executive department.
summary: Formal recipient of Qatar's Boeing 747-8.

name: Senate Finance Committee (Wyden)
role: Congressional committee; Sen. Ron Wyden chair (2021–2025), then ranking member.
summary: Ran an investigation into Affinity Partners' foreign funding and 666 Fifth Avenue.

name: House Oversight Committee Democrats
role: Minority staff of the House Committee on Oversight.
summary: Authored the January 2024 report on foreign-government payments to Trump businesses; 2026 letters on Kushner.

name: House Judiciary Committee Democrats (Raskin)
role: Minority of the House Judiciary Committee.
summary: Opened a 2026 inquiry into Affinity Partners and Kushner's envoy role.

name: Jerusalem recognition & embassy relocation (2017–18)
role: Proclamation 9683 (Dec 6, 2017); interim embassy opened May 2018.
summary: Formal US recognition of Jerusalem as Israel's capital.

name: Golan Heights recognition (2019)
role: Proclamation 9852 (Mar 25, 2019).
summary: US recognition of the Golan Heights as part of Israel.

name: Settlements legal position (2019)
role: Secretary Pompeo's statement of Nov 18, 2019.
summary: The US stopped treating West Bank settlements as per se inconsistent with international law.

name: "Peace to Prosperity" economic plan (2019–20)
role: $50 billion proposed investment framework presented by Kushner, June 2019.
summary: Proposal only; funders were not identified and it was conditional on a political settlement.

name: Abraham Accords (2020)
role: Normalization agreements signed at the White House, Sept 15, 2020.
summary: Israel–UAE and Israel–Bahrain normalization, with the US as witness.

name: Emergency arms sales to Israel (Feb 2025)
role: Emergency determination bypassing congressional review.
summary: Munitions and bulldozer sales totalling roughly $3 billion.

name: 2016 US–Israel Memorandum of Understanding
role: $38 billion military assistance framework, FY2019–2028 (signed under President Obama).
summary: Context only. The baseline aid framework predates the Trump administration.

name: Gaza "takeover" proposal (Feb 2025)
role: Proposal announced at Feb 4, 2025 press conference.
summary: Trump proposed US long-term ownership and redevelopment of Gaza.

name: 20-point Gaza plan & Board of Peace (2025–26)
role: White House plan of Sept 29, 2025; Board of Peace chaired by Trump.
summary: Ceasefire and post-war governance framework; the Board oversees reconstruction funding.

name: Acceptance of Qatari 747-8 (2025)
role: Department of Defense acceptance, May 2025; MOU July 2025.
summary: Aircraft accepted as a gift to the US government for conversion to presidential use.
